def find_min(index, value):
    value = abs(value)
    if index == 0:
        return int(value)
    q = int(value // pattern[index])
    q_plus = q + 1
    cost_q = q * (index + 1) + find_min(index - 1, value - q * pattern[index])
    cost_qp = q_plus * (index + 1) + find_min(index - 1, value - q_plus * pattern[index])
    return min(cost_q, cost_qp)
